## Survey open-0: LIN-4468 @ e666c4b60

**Where the difficulty is: the second token.** It isn't the first mint. `attachProxyContext` already receives `writes` (LIN-4251) from dispatch-entrance and the follow-up arms. It only reaches the prose today, so the first stamp is plumbing. The open path is the re-arm lane. The runner mints a fresh bootstrap through `POST /api/dispatch/broker-token` in three places: the fresh-launch self-heal (`dispatcher.js:1355`), the wake self-heal (`:1089`) and the stall-failsafe refire (`reapers.js:2135`). Each call sends `{ itemId }`. Harbour reads that id only when the row carries a **grant declaration**. For an ordinary reading stage it falls through to a plain `createToken({ kind: 'bootstrap', label: 'refire-broker' })` (`routes/dispatch.js:1522`), and the record-less branch of `provisionResumeCredential` mints through `provisionBootstrapToken` with no `writes`. Both produce an unstamped token. Under the plan's "unstamped = unrestricted", a look-into session that stalls and gets refired comes back as `work`. This lane isn't among the plan's four places, and the source scan for the four helpers won't find it.

`getItemFeedback` returns the row without its prompt, and the row already holds `kind` and `issueIdentifier`. The broker route, which already checks that the caller is the row's taker, can resolve `writes` from `row.kind` and stamp the new token, with no runner or dispatch-store change. Note that `routes/dispatch.js` collides with #2427.

**Target matching can't happen entirely in `requireWriteScope`.** That middleware is synchronous and runs before provider access is resolved. `:issueId` arrives as a key, a UUID, or a Jira or GitHub form, and turning a UUID back into the stamped key takes a provider read. Verb and route checks can go in middleware. The ticket-identity check belongs after `guardTarget` inside `guarded()`, reading the same table. "One table, two enforcement points" is a fair correction to the plan, and it should go on LIN-4448.

**Route discovery is new ground.** No test reads the router stack yet (Express 4, nested `router.use` sub-routers, array paths such as the comments POST). The census will also bring up writes the ticket's mount list doesn't cover: `rulings` (a `none` token could answer a DECISION), `dispatch/halt`, `model-routing`, `foreman/status`, `autopilot/manual`, and the grant-gated `runner/*` routes, which don't use `requireWriteScope` at all. Each needs a ruling, not just a label.

**Drift since `5dcf5bcda`.** About 30 commits have landed since then, not just LIN-4457. In `proxy-writes.js`, `checkBlindRead` now comes from `lib/run-trail.js`. PATCH now refuses a non-UUID `assigneeId`/`parentId`/`cycleId` with a 400 before any read (LIN-4452). So the triage field filter has to run before that check, or the witness for `PATCH {assigneeId:"bob"}` will see a 400 instead of a 403. Line references have shifted slightly (`requireWriteScope` is at :608, PATCH at :512).

**What I'd do first:** write the failing witness for the re-arm lane. Mint a `none` dispatch, call `/api/dispatch/broker-token` with its `itemId`, exchange the result, and POST a comment. Today that succeeds. Then stamp the token doc and the exchange, and land the route census as a characterization test before adding any enforcement. It names the unruled writes while the change is small.

## Survey global: LIN-4468 @ e666c4b60

**Where it lands.** The change lands in `lib/proxy-tokens.js`, `routes/proxy.js` and `routes/proxy-writes.js`, plus a short edit at each mint caller. The trend is good. `proxy.js` keeps moving routes out into `routes/proxy-*.js` sub-routers. `proxy-writes.js` has one `SPEC` table (route → capability) and a row of `refusedBy*` guards (As asked, size record, blind read, periodical gate). An allowance check fits there as one more guard. The token document has gained fields one at a time, each threaded by hand. The stamp is the fifth, so the plan's four places are right. The field list at the top of the file (:13-17) and `validateToken`'s return (:726) must learn it too. Most of the plumbing exists: `writes` already reaches `attachProxyContext` and the resume attach arms (LIN-4251). The stamp only has to go one hop further, into `provisionBootstrapToken`.

**Where the obvious way goes wrong.**
- *`requireWriteScope` can't hold the whole check.* It runs before `resolveProviderAccess`, so it can't resolve a provider UUID or a Jira or GitHub id to the stamped ticket. Only `guardTarget` (inside `guarded()`) has that read. Put the coarse class check in the middleware and the target check after `guardTarget`. Both should read one table in `lib/stage-writes.js`, keyed by `SPEC` op names (`createComment`, `updateIssue` plus fields, `addLabel`…), so `SPEC` doesn't become a second classification. Keep the table plain data so `stage-writes.js` stays a leaf.
- *Routes the ticket doesn't name.* Comment PATCH/DELETE, attachments, and the halt, model-routing, rulings, kickoff and compute mounts all carry `requireWriteScope`. Each needs a row, or it falls through as allowed.
- *A mint the scan misses.* The refire broker (`routes/dispatch.js` ~:1522) mints with a bare `createToken`, and its declared arm calls `provisionResumeCredential` with no `attach`. Neither carries `writes`, so a refired look-into would come back unrestricted. A scan for the four helper names won't find `createToken`. `tests/unit/dispatch-entrance-mint-sweep.test.js` already spies `createToken` and `mintGrantBootstrap` at the store boundary, and pins the broker's options exactly. Extend that sweep. A second source scan beside it would be a second list that drifts.
- *Docs that would quietly go untrue.* `docs/proxy-integration.md` :90 ("`readWrite`: all read access plus create/update/delete…") and `docs/architecture/prompt-system.md` :12 (says `writes` only reaches the preamble) each need a line. No test reads either.

**What this task can carry.** One table keyed by `SPEC` ops. The broker stamped from the refired row's kind. The existing mint sweep extended. The route-discovery test built on the `router.stack` walk that `dispatch-entrance-session-owner-sweep.test.js` already uses.

**Not this task's to carry.** Every new token field has to be wired four times (`#mint`, `createToken`, `mintGrantBootstrap`, exchange). One claims object that `#mint` copies and callers can only narrow would end that. It touches every Agent API mint, so it belongs in a Waiting entry, not here. plan-review still declares `work`, so this guard won't hold it.

### Leftovers

No touched area holds a fix-sized Waiting entry, so this build settles none. The touched areas are agent-api (12 Waiting entries), runs-and-dispatch (22) and other-features (4). The agent-api entry about the stage on the token is rewritten in this PR, since the proxy now knows the stage; its read-guard half stays waiting.

Retires: none, nothing fix-sized: the smallest is `lib/dispatch-feedback-kinds.js`: its `mayCarryWake` column, larger than a fix because removing it or making it true to both wake readers changes wake minting (LIN-4455).

## LIN-4468 (piece 4): done, PR open and CI green

PR: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2443 (commit 23a27b039, branch `feat/lin-4468-stage-write-allowance`)

**What it does.** A stage's `writes` and its one ticket are stamped on its proxy token at mint, carried through the exchange onto `req`, and enforced at two points over one table (`lib/stage-writes.js`). The route gate (`lib/stage-write-gate.js`) refuses an operation the allowance does not list, before any read. The ticket match (`routes/proxy-writes.js` `guardTarget`) refuses a write to any ticket but the target. The refire broker no longer mints an unrestricted token for a restricted row.

**Evidence.**
- CI: all 8 checks pass, including `CI success`, on run 43507430458.
- Local full unit suite: 25,871 tests, 0 failures.
- New witnesses: 72 in `tests/unit/lin-4468-stage-write-allowance.test.js`, plus 2 refire witnesses in `tests/unit/lin-3135-broker-refire-declared.test.js`.
- Mutation checks, restored afterwards: allowance disabled fails 44 witnesses, ticket match disabled fails 4, refire stamp dropped fails both refire witnesses.

**Retires.** "read-only is only words" (stageWrites reached only the preamble prose). Look-into's "post nothing to Linear unless the person asks" exception: look-into keeps `writes: none`; the prompt wording stays until LIN-4469.

**Decisions for review** (also on the PR and in the LIN-4448 comment): default deny for routes nobody classified yet; a missing row mints stage-less; ticket-fields may create comments but not edit or delete them; ticket reads remain ungated.

**Still open.** Merge is not mine: it follows review approval. After merge, LIN-1273 and LIN-1242 get the comment in the ticket brief, and LIN-1273 and all of LIN-1242 stay open.

### Leftovers

PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2443, head 8e0cf2d8b604fc57f671b5c8e14523c856daac54 (CI green: 8 of 8, run 43510200987). This answer replaces the one posted before the leftover step ran.

- tidied: `requireWriteScope` is a factory now, and the JSDoc in seven routers said plain middleware (`routes/proxy-writes.js` and six others).
- tidied: comments the change made untrue: the preamble's "the mint is unaffected", the broker's R2 comment, the `lib/stage-writes.js` header and its source-map line, and the missing stamp parameters on the five mint helpers' JSDoc.
- tidied: `lib/proxy-instructions.js` told every read-write token it may modify data. A restricted token now gets a line naming its allowance; other tokens get the same catalog, byte for byte.
- tidied: the PATCH field list had two homes. The handler's emptiness check reads `ISSUE_PATCH_FIELDS`, and a pin holds the handler's destructuring to it, so the triage gate sees every field the PATCH can write.
- tidied: a second router walker. The census uses `enumerateRoutes` (new opt-in `chain`), and the proxy's path-scoped layers have one list, `PROXY_ALLOWED_LAYERS`, in place of three copies.
- tidied: the brief's mint sweep extension, missing from the first push. World S of `tests/unit/dispatch-entrance-mint-sweep.test.js` drives a restricted stage through every mint origin, and its header lists the stage-less mints with reasons.
- noted, agent-api note: a Lesson that a stage's mint carries its `writes` and ticket or a listed reason (`lib/proxy-preamble.js`).
- for close-out: nothing; no outside find needs a ticket.

Retires: `routes/proxy.js`: the `proxyLimiter` window (60 seconds) and the broker's wait cap match by comment only. `PROXY_LIMITER_WINDOW_MS` is exported and `tests/unit/proxy-limiter-window-contract.test.js` reads it against the contract's cap row.

## Review — LIN-4468

PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2443, head `8e0cf2d8b604fc57f671b5c8e14523c856daac54` (one commit behind main, mergeable).

CI: green, 8 of 8 checks on the head (run 43510200987). I also re-ran locally: the 4 new or changed suites pass 178/178, and the full unit suite passes 25,883/25,883.

### Finding 1 (blocking): wake tokens take the child's stamp, but they resume the parent

`buildWakeCredentialProvisioner` gets `itemStamp: { store, itemId }`, and `itemId` is the **reporting** row. That is `/api/dispatch/feedback/:itemId` (`routes/dispatch.js:1617`) and `/api/proxy/runner/feedback/:id` (`routes/proxy-runner.js:207`). The wake does not resume that row. It resumes the **parent** session, `edgeDoc.sessionId` (`lib/dispatch-store.js` ~:3890–3919: "The donor is the PARENT session … not the finished child `doc`"). The code comment "the woken row's stage stamps the wake token" is wrong about which row that is.

**Repro.** I added a scratch test on the harness of `tests/unit/dispatch-wake-credential-provisioning.test.js`, deleted after the run. It uses a real store and a real mint → exchange → validate. The parent is `implementation` (work) on LIN-1. Its child reports `[done]` on LIN-42.

| child kind | wake token after the exchange | expected |
|---|---|---|
| `look-into` | `writes: none`, target LIN-42 | unrestricted (the parent's `work`) |
| `survey-task` | `writes: one-comment`, target LIN-42 | unrestricted |
| `implementation` | unstamped | unrestricted ✔ |

**Impact.** Today, any work session (implementation, autopilot, plan…) that dispatches a survey, look-into, context, blind-read or retro child gets back a token that cannot write after the wake. This ticket's own build is an example: it dispatched Survey open-0 and Survey global. The reverse case is also wrong: a restricted parent woken by a work child would get the child's stamp. This is inside the scope. It is the ticket's "follow-up's token takes its own kind's `writes`, not its parent's" rule applied to the wrong row, and it breaks a claim the change depends on: that unrestricted stages keep today's behaviour.

**Fix (implementation):** stamp the wake from the session the wake resumes: the parent row's kind and `issueIdentifier`, the row the store reads as `parentStatus`. Apply it in both feedback routes. The ticket says to leave `lib/dispatch-store.js` alone. If the parent can't be resolved through public store reads (child row → `sessionId` / the `followUpTo` edge), say so on LIN-4448 rather than reaching into store privates. Then add witnesses on both feedback routes: (a) a work parent woken by a restricted child gets an unstamped wake token; (b) a restricted parent woken by a work child keeps its own stamp.

**Sibling in the same class:** the held-wake release provisioner in `server.js:1147` (`setWakeCredentialProvisionerFactory`) mints with no stamp. It is also missing from the stage-less list in the header of `tests/unit/dispatch-entrance-mint-sweep.test.js`. That breaks the ticket's mint-paths rule and the PR's own new agent-api Lesson. Stamp it the same way, or list it with its reason. **Inside** (mint paths bullet).

### Finding 2: two mint stamps have no witness (mutation check)

I removed each stamp in turn and ran the 3 LIN-4468 suites (176 tests). The full unit suite gives the same result.
- Allowance check made always-true (`stageWriteAllows`): 46 fail ✔
- Ticket match off (`outsideStageTarget` → false): 4 fail ✔
- Exchange drops `writes`: 4 fail ✔
- Broker plain mint drops `stampMintOptions`: 2 fail ✔. Broker declared arm drops it: 1 fails ✔
- Triage field filter off: 4 fail ✔
- **Wake stamp off** (`lib/wake-credential.js`, `itemStamp` ignored): **0 fail, full suite 25,883/25,883 green** ✘
- **`enqueueFollowUp` stamp off** (`lib/follow-up-dispatch.js:269`): **0 fail, full suite green** ✘

The ticket requires that each witness fail before the change. The wake witness comes with Finding 1. For `enqueueFollowUp`, its live callers today (leftover, ci-wake, reply box) are all kind-less, so `work`. Add a witness that a restricted `kind` through `enqueueFollowUp` is stamped with the parent's ticket, or drop the code path and list it stage-less. **Inside.**

All mutations were reverted. `git status` is clean.

### Finding 3: identifier forms are only partly exercised

The testing bullet asks for the preamble endpoints to be exercised under each provider's identifier form (lowercase, provider UUID, GitHub, Jira). The HTTP witnesses use one fake provider with `LIN-9`, `lin-9` and a fake `uuid-9`. No GitHub or Jira stamped target is tested (`owner/repo#N` / `#N` / number, or a Jira key against its numeric id). I read the real `issueWriteGuard` on Linear, Jira and GitHub, and each returns an `id` the comparison can use, so the code looks right. The witness is still missing. Add over-HTTP cases with a Jira-shaped and a GitHub-shaped fake provider (key vs numeric id; `#12` vs `12`). **Inside.**

### Checked and fine
- Every write route is in the census: I grepped every proxy write in `routes/` and `server.js`, and only `recap`/`brief` (not-ticket) sit outside the write mounts. Dispatch and agent status are gated. `/api/proxy/token` is exempt.
- Triage `PATCH {assigneeId:"bob"}` gets a 403 before the 400 from LIN-4452's UUID refusal. `checkBlindRead` and the As asked / size-record guards are untouched. Regression check: no recent fix to these files is undone.
- Unstamped and `work` tokens keep the exact mint shapes (`stampMintOptions` adds no keys). An unknown stamp fails closed to `none`.
- The four decisions left for review: I agree with each. Default deny matches "unknown fails closed". Stage-less on a missing row is the LIN-3135 R2 shape, and it is listed. Allowing `ticket-fields` comment create but not edit/delete is the safer reading of "comments on their own routes". Reads are outside this ticket's writes scope; the reads half is the rewritten agent-api Waiting entry.
- The `Retires:` line names the `proxyLimiter` window Waiting entry, and the diff removes it ✔.

### What CI Did Not Prove
- **Inside**: a woken work parent keeps an unrestricted token (Finding 1). Settle before the merge with the witnesses named above. Exact precondition: a parent of kind `implementation` and a child of kind `survey-task`; POST `[done]` to `/api/dispatch/feedback/:childId` and to `/api/proxy/runner/feedback/:childId`; the exchanged wake token validates with `writes: null`.
- **Inside**: the held-wake release mint (`server.js:1147`) is stamped or listed stage-less. Settle before the merge by a sweep row or a header entry.
- **Inside**: the `enqueueFollowUp` stamp has a witness that fails without it. Settle before the merge.
- **Inside**: alternate ticket ids for GitHub and Jira match the stamped target, and other tickets are refused. Settle before the merge by the over-HTTP cases in Finding 3. After the deploy, check once on a Linear workspace: a `one-comment` token posting to its ticket by Linear UUID gets 2xx, and to another ticket gets a 403 that names the target.
- **Inside**: the real runner refire lane. simple-dispatcher calls `/api/dispatch/broker-token` with `itemId`, and the re-minted token is restricted. It is witnessed in-process only. After the deploy: refire a stalled `look-into` run and confirm its comment POST gets a 403 that names `none`. Rollback: revert the PR's merge commit. Every token minted since carries an extra field that legacy code ignores, so the revert is clean.
- **Inside**, after the merge: the comments on LIN-1273 and on LIN-1242 (#1, #9) with the PR, naming the parts that stay open. Neither ticket is closed.

### Verdict
Request Changes

Against the As asked block: stamping at mint and carrying it through the exchange, `validateToken` and `req` is met. One table in `lib/stage-writes.js` is met, with two enforcement points (a justified correction, recorded on LIN-4448). The four mint places are met. Each allowance is met. Case-insensitive target matching with a 403 that names the target is met. The route-discovery test is met. Look-into stays `none` by John's ruling, and the preamble prose is unchanged. **Not met:** "Each [mint path] passes its stage's allowance, or is listed as stage-less". The wake paths pass the wrong row's allowance, and the held-wake release passes none and is not listed. Also not met: "each witness fails before the change", for the wake and `enqueueFollowUp` stamps, and the GitHub and Jira identifier forms.

**Next action: `implementation`** on this task, for Findings 1–3. No new ticket. Review re-runs after.

## LIN-4468: review findings addressed (commit 5a544028f)

PR: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2443 (same branch, same PR; no new PR)

**CI** green on 5a544028f (run 43514208288): CI success, Unit tests, Unit tests (proxy, clock +400d), E2E shards 1-4, secret scan.

**Finding 1, wake token stamped from the reporting child (fixed).** `stampForWakeParent` (lib/item-stage-stamp.js) resolves the resumed parent through the public `resolveFollowUpRoot` and stamps from its row. lib/wake-credential.js uses it, so both feedback routes take the parent's stage. Witnesses: tests/unit/lin-4468-wake-stamp.test.js, 6 tests on both routes, real store and real ProxyTokenStore, mint, exchange, validate. Mutation (stamp from the reporting row): 6 of 6 fail.
- **Held-wake sibling (server.js, setWakeCredentialProvisionerFactory): NOT fixed.** The factory gets no resumed-parent id, so it mints unstamped. It needs a store-side argument, which the brief keeps out of lib/dispatch-store.js. Raised as a DECISION on LIN-4448. Not listed as stage-less, because it does resume a parent.

**Finding 2, enqueueFollowUp stamp had no witness (fixed).** Added: a survey-task follow-up of a look-into parent on LIN-9 mints one-comment on LIN-9, and an implementation follow-up is unstamped. Mutation (stamp removed): fails with writes null, expected one-comment.

**Finding 3, Jira and GitHub ids over HTTP (fixed).** tests/unit/lin-4468-stage-write-allowance.test.js: Jira-shaped (PROJ-12 and 10012) and GitHub-shaped (#12 and 12, stamped target owner/repo#12) cases. Mutation (provider id resolution removed): the three "allowed" identifier witnesses fail. The proxy path accepts `#N` and `N` only (ISSUE_ID_REGEX). `owner/repo#N` in the path is refused 400 before the gate, and that is pinned.

**Docs:** docs/areas/agent-api.md Lesson now names the held-wake exception, rather than claiming every stage mint is stamped or listed.

**Not done here (post-merge, per the brief):** comments on LIN-1273 and LIN-1242; the deployed checks (Linear UUID comment on the allowed ticket, refire of a stalled look-into through the real runner).

### Engineering settlement: the held-wake credential stamp (autopilot)

This is an engineering scoping question, not one of John's calls (no product, money or retirement question), so it is settled here with reasons.

**Settled: allow the minimal change in `lib/dispatch-store.js`.** Pass the resumed parent id from `releaseHeldWake` (`plan.edgeDoc.sessionId`) into the factory, forward it into `buildWakeCredentialProvisioner`'s `itemStamp` in `server.js`, and add a witness that a held wake to a `none` parent is refused a comment (with a mutation check, as for the other stamps).

**Why:** the ticket's goal is that the limit is held in code, and the review classed this sibling as inside the ticket's mint-paths bullet. Listing it as a stated exception would leave a known hole in the one claim this piece exists to make. The change is one argument and changes no wake-minting logic. It is not a regression (unstamped is how it behaved before), so it does not need to block on anyone's ruling.

**Constraint:** keep the change to that argument, nothing else in the store. LIN-4447 (Runs) owns the file, and a notice is posted there.

The LIN-4448 comment titled `DECISION: held-wake credential stamp` is answered by this settlement.

Allow the store change and add a held-wake witness

— Ruling recorded via Harbour

## LIN-4468: held-wake stamp done (commit f5dab00f6)

PR: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2443 (same branch, same PR)

Ruling applied (LIN-4448 DECISION: allow the store change and add a held-wake witness).

- `lib/dispatch-store.js` releaseHeldWake now hands its provisioner factory the producing build's id (`itemId`), the same row a feedback route passes.
- `lib/wake-credential.js` `buildHeldWakeProvisionerFactory` is the factory server.js binds. A held wake is stamped through `stampForWakeParent`, the same as an immediate wake. No wake-minting logic changes.
- Witnesses in tests/unit/lin-4468-wake-stamp.test.js: a look-into parent woken by a held release keeps `none` on LIN-9, and an autopilot parent stays unrestricted. Mutation (itemId dropped from the store call): the restricted witness fails with writes null, expected none.
- The LIN-4373 pin on the factory's arguments now includes `itemId`. The agent-api Lesson no longer carries an open exception. The mint-sweep header names the wake witnesses.

Every wake path (both feedback routes, held release) now takes the resumed parent's stage. Targeted suites: 598/598 locally. CI on f5dab00f6 is running; result to follow in the session report.

## LIN-4468 revision: review findings addressed, CI green

PR: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2443 (same branch, same PR, no new PR). Head `d0fc1dc65`.

**CI:** green on `d0fc1dc65` (run 43516453044): Unit tests, Unit tests (proxy, clock +400d), E2E shards 1-4, secret scan, CI success. The PR is MERGEABLE.

**Finding 1, a wake token takes the child's stamp (fixed, 5a544028f).** A wake now takes the stage of the resumed parent (`stampForWakeParent`, resolved through `resolveFollowUpRoot`), on both feedback routes. Witnesses: `tests/unit/lin-4468-wake-stamp.test.js`, real store, real ProxyTokenStore, mint → exchange → validate. Mutation (stamp from the reporting row): 6 of 6 fail.

**Finding 1, held-wake sibling (fixed, f5dab00f6 + 39b76bfe8).** A held wake's release now takes the resumed parent's stage. The store hands the factory the producing build's id (the same edge root `_planWake` resolves). `buildHeldWakeProvisionerFactory` always stamps through that row. A release with no producing id is refused, never minted unstamped (the fail-open the constraints forbid).
- Witness: the held-wake token, exchanged and validated, gets a 403 from the proxy comment route over HTTP naming the allowance `(none)`, and nothing is written.
- Mutation: null stamp restored for a missing id → the no-id witness fails (a token is minted). Store stops passing the id → 4 witnesses fail, all closed (no wake token).
- Note: the settlement on LIN-4448 said to pass `edgeDoc.sessionId`; the landed version passes the build id and resolves the same parent. Equivalent, so I kept it.

**Finding 2, enqueueFollowUp stamp had no witness (fixed, 5a544028f).** Survey-task follow-up of a look-into parent mints `one-comment` on LIN-9; implementation follow-up is unstamped. Mutation (stamp removed) fails.

**Finding 3, Jira and GitHub ids over HTTP (fixed, 5a544028f).** Jira-shaped (`PROJ-12` and `10012`) and GitHub-shaped (`#12` and `12`, target `owner/repo#12`) cases. Mutation (provider id resolution removed): the three "allowed" identifier witnesses fail. `owner/repo#N` in the path is refused 400 before the gate, and that is pinned.

**Merge with main (d0fc1dc65).** Main had LIN-4467 and LIN-4463. Conflicts were in `lib/proxy-instructions.js` and two architecture docs; both sides kept. Bearing unit suites: 676/676 on the merged tree.

**Docs:** `docs/areas/agent-api.md` Lesson no longer carries the held-wake exception.

**Not done here (post-merge, per the brief):** comments on LIN-1273 and LIN-1242 (#1, #9) once merged; neither ticket is closed. Post-deploy checks: a Linear-UUID comment on the allowed ticket gets 2xx and another ticket gets a 403 naming the target; refire a stalled `look-into` through the real runner and confirm its comment is refused. Merge waits on review approval.

## Review — LIN-4468

PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2443, head `d0fc1dc65e1ff8df75abfbb394c3e57f4a962bbe` (MERGEABLE; includes main's LIN-4467/LIN-4463). This re-review follows the Request Changes at `8e0cf2d8b`.

CI: green, 8 of 8 checks on head `d0fc1dc65` (run 43516453044), including `CI success`. I re-ran the bearing suites locally on the head (the LIN-4468 suites, LIN-3135 refire, the mint sweep, the LIN-4373 leftover step and wake-credential provisioning): 263/263 pass.

### Prior findings, re-checked

**Finding 1, wake tokens took the child's stamp: fixed.** `stampForWakeParent` (`lib/item-stage-stamp.js`) uses the public `resolveFollowUpRoot(childId)` and stamps from `root.sessionId`. I read the store: `resolveFollowUpRoot` → `_resolveEdgeDoc` is the same walk `_planWake` uses to get `edgeDoc`, and the wake goes to `edgeDoc.sessionId` (`buildWakeFollowUp`). The reporting row is in history when `addFeedback` runs (`findOneAndUpdate` on `historyCollection`), so the root resolves.
- **Open question from the brief: build id instead of `edgeDoc.sessionId`.** The two routes are equivalent. The store passes `build._id`, and `_planWake(build)` resolves its edge from that same row. I accept it.
- **Unresolvable parent.** `buildWakeFollowUp` already returns null when there is no `sessionId`, so a live wake never reaches the throw. A held release with no id throws inside the provisioner's try, so the wake goes ahead with no token. Nothing is minted unstamped.

**Finding 1 sibling, the held-wake release: fixed under the ruling** ("Allow the store change and add a held-wake witness", `lin4468-held-wake-stamp`). The `lib/dispatch-store.js` change is the one argument `itemId: build._id` plus JSDoc. No wake-minting logic changes. `server.js` binds `buildHeldWakeProvisionerFactory`, which always stamps.

**Finding 2, the `enqueueFollowUp` stamp had no witness: fixed.**

**Finding 3, Jira and GitHub identifier forms: fixed.** There are over-HTTP cases for `PROJ-12`/`10012` and for `#12`/`12` with stamped target `owner/repo#12`. Another ticket gets a 403 naming the target. `owner/repo#N` in the path gets a 400, and that is pinned.

### Mutation checks (mine, each reverted, `git status` clean)
- Wake stamped from the reporting row (`stampForItem` in place of `stampForWakeParent`): 9 fail (both feedback routes and the held release).
- Wake stamp dropped (always unstamped): 7 fail.
- Store stops passing `itemId` to the held-wake factory: 4 fail (3 LIN-4468, 1 LIN-4373).
- `enqueueFollowUp` stamp removed: 1 fails (`survey-task follow-up of a look-into parent … one-comment on LIN-9`).

The earlier mutations (allowance, ticket match, exchange, broker arms, triage field filter) were verified in the previous review. The code under them is unchanged apart from the merge.

### Other checks
- **Merge resolution.** `lib/proxy-instructions.js` keeps main's `STAGE_KINDS`/`OVERRIDE_KINDS` and the PR's allowance line. Both sides are present.
- **Regression.** No recent fix to `lib/wake-credential.js`, `server.js` or `lib/dispatch-store.js` is undone. LIN-4455's late-bound release wording and the LIN-4373 held-wake hook are intact, and their suites pass.
- **Isolated, or one of a class?** The class is "a mint path for a stage session". Every wake path (dispatch feedback, runner feedback, held release), the refire broker (both arms), the four helpers and `enqueueFollowUp` now pass the right stage. The mint-sweep header lists the stage-less paths with reasons. No unhandled sibling is left.
- **Retires.** The `Retires:` line names the `proxyLimiter` window Waiting entry, and the diff still removes it from `docs/areas/agent-api.md`. ✔
- **Rulings.** The only ruling (`lin4468-held-wake-stamp`) is answered and applied. The look-into ruling (exception retired, `none` kept) is resolved. I raise no new DECISION.

### What CI Did Not Prove
- **Inside** (Linear UUID target form; the "resolve alternate provider ids" bullet). CI runs fake providers only. **After the deploy:** on a real Linear workspace, a `one-comment` token posts a comment to its stamped ticket by its Linear UUID and gets 2xx, then posts to another ticket and gets a 403 that names the stamped key. Rollback: revert the PR's merge commit. Tokens minted in the meantime carry an extra field that legacy code ignores, so the revert is clean.
- **Inside** (the refire lane: simple-dispatcher calls `POST /api/dispatch/broker-token` with `{ itemId }`). This is witnessed in-process only, not through the real runner. **After the deploy:** refire a stalled `look-into` run through the real runner and confirm its comment POST gets a 403 naming allowance `none`. Rollback: the same merge-commit revert.
- **Inside** (a real held-wake release in production: a parent woken after a leftover row finishes). Witnessed in-process with a real store and a real `ProxyTokenStore`. **After the deploy:** the next held release for a restricted parent logs no `no-retry-degraded … wake parent unresolvable`, and its wake token validates with the parent's `writes`. Monitor: the `[dispatch-wake] no-retry-degraded` log line, which fires on a failed stamp resolution. Only real traffic produces such a release.
- **Inside**, after the merge (the brief's "After merge" step): comment on LIN-1273 and on LIN-1242 (#1 and #9) with the PR, saying that their read-only scope is now held at the proxy. Name what stays open: merge goes to LIN-3417 / simple-dispatcher, and the Done capability (`work` keeps it) and LIN-1242's staleness lift stay where they are. Close neither ticket. LIN-1372, LIN-1395 and LIN-1408 stay with A12 / the harness.

### Verdict
Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger

The As asked block, sentence by sentence:
- **A reading stage cannot make a tracker write it is not allowed to make, and the proxy enforces `writes` from the token.** Met.
- **Approach.**
  - Stamped at mint and carried through the exchange, `validateToken` and `req`: met.
  - One allowance table in `lib/stage-writes.js`: met, enforced at two points (the correction is recorded on LIN-4448).
  - The four explicit places (`#mint`, `createToken` narrowing only, `mintGrantBootstrap`, the exchange): met.
  - Each allowance (`none`, `one-comment`/`blind-comment` with `checkBlindRead` kept, `ticket-fields` with the field allow-list and refusals, `work`/unstamped unchanged, unknown fails closed): met.
  - Case-insensitive target matching, alternate ids resolved, and a 403 that names the ticket: met. Linear UUIDs are confirmed live by ledger item 1.
  - A follow-up takes its own kind's `writes`: met. The wake now correctly takes the resumed parent's.
- **Mint paths.** Each one passes its stage's allowance or is listed stage-less with its reason: now met, including the wakes and the held release.
- **Runner and store.** The runner is untouched. `lib/dispatch-store.js` has one argument, by ruling.
- **Preamble prose.** Unchanged.
- **Testing.**
  - Every witness named: present.
  - Each witness fails before the change: confirmed by mutation.
  - The route-discovery test fails on an unclassified or unguarded write: present, with recap, brief and flight-companion classified and `/api/proxy/token` exempt.
- **Needs a ruling before merge.** Answered (exception retired).
- **After merge.** Ledger item 4.
- **Collisions.** Respected.
- **Retires.** Named and removed.

Next: `close-out`. Re-check CI on `d0fc1dc65` (or on the merged head, if main moves), merge, then run ledger item 4 and the post-deploy checks.

## Blind read
Verdict: better. The readWrite check moves out of a closure inside `routes/proxy.js` into one gate (`lib/stage-write-gate.js`), every write mount names its operation, and a census over the live router pins it. `ISSUE_PATCH_FIELDS` replaces the PATCH handler's inline field list, and the limiter window is now read by a test against the broker's cap. Against that: the gate's header describes wiring the routers don't use, a follow-up's stamp is worked out twice in `lib/dispatch-entrance.js`, and the comment route reads another ticket before the stage-target check runs (`routes/proxy-writes.js`).

Read: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2443 at `d0fc1dc65` against `6348e5781`.

### Inside the area, fix-sized
- `routes/proxy-writes.js` (agent-api): on the comment route, `refusedByBlindRead` runs before `guardTarget`. It reads the target ticket's comment trail (`fetchIssueComments`) and can answer 422 with `expected`/`got` landing-PR URLs. So a `blind-comment` token pointed at another ticket learns that ticket's PR set before the stage-target 403. That breaks the rule `guardTarget`'s own comment states ("before any answer about the issue"). Fix: run `guardTarget` (or `outsideStageTarget`) before `refusedByBlindRead`.
- `lib/stage-write-gate.js` (other-features): the header says the gate is "Imported by every write mount, so no router takes the gate as a dependency that a test or a caller could leave out". At HEAD only `routes/proxy-runner.js` imports it. `routes/proxy-writes.js`, `proxy-dispatch.js`, `proxy-kickoff.js`, `proxy-halt.js`, `proxy-agent-status.js`, `proxy-model-routing.js` and `proxy-rulings.js` still take `requireWriteScope` injected, and tests pass a no-op `() => (req,res,next) => next()` (`tests/unit/proxy-rulings-routes.test.js`). Fix: make the comment say what is true (proxy.js imports it and injects it; the runner router imports it).
- `docs/areas/areas.json` (other-features, for `lib/stage-write-gate.js`): the registry didn't learn about the two new modules. `lib/stage-write-gate.js` is the proxy's write gate (it imports `proxy-scopes.js`, and every `routes/proxy*.js` mount uses it). `lib/item-stage-stamp.js` reads dispatch rows for wake and follow-up mints. Both fall through to the catch-all `^lib/`. Fix: add `stage-write-gate` to agent-api's pattern and `item-stage-stamp` to runs-and-dispatch's.
- `tests/unit/lin-4468-stage-write-allowance.test.js` (other-features, for `lib/stage-writes.js`): "every SPEC operation name is a known write operation" checks a hand-copied `SPEC_OPS` list, not `SPEC` in `routes/proxy-writes.js`. A new SPEC key would pass that test, so the test doesn't check what its name says (the route census only catches a new key once a route is mounted). Fix: read the keys from `SPEC` (export them, or parse the source as the PATCH-field test does).

### Inside the area, larger
- `lib/dispatch-entrance.js` (runs-and-dispatch): one follow-up mint gets its stamp two ways. `attach` carries `writes: stageWrites(resolvedKind)` with `attachIssue` as the ticket (via `attachProxyContext`, `lib/proxy-preamble.js`). `stampForFollowUp` gives the same `writes` with the parent row's `issueIdentifier` and is spread beside it. Which one applies depends on whether `attach` is set. `lib/follow-up-dispatch.js` has only the second. The next change to how a follow-up is stamped has to find both. This is larger than a fix because unifying them means deciding which ticket wins (attach issue or parent row) across `lib/proxy-preamble.js` and two entrances.
- `routes/proxy-writes.js` (agent-api): the write gate now comes in two ways. `routes/proxy-runner.js` imports `requireStageWrite` so a test can't drop it, while every other proxy router takes `requireWriteScope` as an injected dependency that tests replace with a pass-through. Moving them all to one way touches seven routers and their test harnesses, so it is more than one sitting.

### Outside the area
None.

## Close-out — LIN-4468

**Merged:** https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2443, squash commit `b937237a4`, pinned with `--match-head-commit 34cefe025` (the commit CI passed on). **Deployed:** harbour.cat footer read `b937237a4` after the merge.

**How it meets what was asked:** review's account stands (Approve at `d0fc1dc65`, sentence by sentence against the As asked block): a stage's `writes` allowance is stamped at mint, carried through the exchange onto `req`, and enforced from one table in `lib/stage-writes.js`. Look-into keeps `none`: John retired the person-requested-comment exception (ruling on LIN-4448); LIN-4469 handles the prompt wording.

**Changes I made after the approval** (nobody reviews these; all on the PR branch, commit `34cefe025`):
1. Blind read, cross-ticket disclosure: `routes/proxy-writes.js` comment route now runs `guardTarget` before `refusedByBlindRead`, so a stage outside its ticket gets the 403 before the other ticket's comment trail is read or its landing PRs appear in a 422. New witness in `tests/unit/lin-4468-stage-write-allowance.test.js`; it fails with the old order (mutation: 1 fail, restored) and passes now. The attachment and comment-edit routes also call the blind read but no restricted allowance permits them, so they are unreachable for a stamped stage.
2. Blind read, gate header: `lib/stage-write-gate.js` now says what is wired (proxy.js imports and injects `requireWriteScope`; proxy-runner.js imports `requireStageWrite` directly).
3. Blind read, registry: `docs/areas/areas.json` maps `lib/stage-write-gate.js` to agent-api and `lib/item-stage-stamp.js` to runs-and-dispatch.
4. Blind read, SPEC test: the "every SPEC operation is classified" test reads `SPEC_OPERATIONS` (a new export from `routes/proxy-writes.js`) instead of a hand-copied list.

**CI:** exists. All 8 checks green on `34cefe025` (run 43518912160): Unit tests, Unit tests (proxy, clock +400d), E2E shards 1-4, Secret scan, CI success. Locally, the full unit suite passed 25,918/25,918 before the push.

**Ledger:**
- Linear-UUID target check (allowed ticket 2xx; another ticket 403 naming the stamped key): **not run.** It needs a restricted (`one-comment`) token on a real Linear workspace; this session cannot mint one and minting credentials is outside the close-out mandate. Someone with a stage token, or John, can run it (post a comment by Linear UUID to the stamped ticket, then to another). Rollback: revert `b937237a4`; tokens minted meanwhile carry an extra field legacy code ignores.
- Look-into refire through the real runner (comment must get a 403 naming allowance `none`): **not run.** It needs a stalled look-into run and simple-dispatcher's runner, which this session does not have. John or whoever runs the runner can run it. Same rollback.
- Next real held-wake release for a restricted parent: **not run, and cannot be.** Only real traffic produces it. Monitor named by review: the `[dispatch-wake] no-retry-degraded … wake parent unresolvable` log line, which fires on a failed stamp resolution; the wake token should validate with the parent's `writes`.
- Comments on LIN-1273 (450cff53) and LIN-1242 (08100759), naming what stays open (merge to LIN-3417 / simple-dispatcher, the Done capability, LIN-1242's staleness lift; LIN-1372/1395/1408 stay with A12 / the harness). **Neither ticket closed.** Done.

**Blind read:** verdict better. Its four fix-sized finds are fixed above. Its two larger inside-area finds (the gate wired two ways across seven routers; a follow-up's stamp worked out twice in `lib/dispatch-entrance.js`, which attach-versus-parent-row ticket wins is undecided) are not fix-sized and nothing is wrong today, so each is a `## Waiting` entry, not a ticket: notes PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2446 (docs only, area-note checks 57/57), **open and unreviewed**. I missed adding these before the merge, so the entries go in after it. Outside finds: none, so no gate tickets filed.

**Related tickets:** LIN-1273, LIN-1242 commented, not closed (above). No other ticket is settled by this work.

**Description:** archived and pruned (see the note on the description below if the snapshot could not be confirmed).

description:
## As asked

Piece 4 of LIN-4448's plan (behaviour **D**). **A reading stage cannot make a tracker write it is not allowed to make.** The proxy enforces each stage's `writes` allowance from the token. This is the long pole: start it early.

**Approach**

* At mint, stamp the bootstrap with the stage's `writes` and its target ticket. Carry both through the working-token exchange, `validateToken` and `authenticateProxyToken` onto `req`. `requireWriteScope` (`routes/proxy.js:609`) enforces **one allowance table in** `lib/stage-writes.js`, beside `WRITES`.
* The stamp does not travel the way `lifetimeProfile` does. Handle it explicitly in four places: `#mint`, `createToken` (which today nulls everything but grants; a caller's stamp may only narrow), `mintGrantBootstrap` (dispatch-entrance's declared-grant branch) and the exchange's working-token mint (`lib/proxy-tokens.js` \~:554-567).
* Allowances:
  * `none`: every write is refused.
  * `one-comment` / `blind-comment`: comment POSTs on the stamped ticket only. Keep the existing blind-read shape check (`checkBlindRead`). "One" is not a count: the token holds no state, so it stays the preamble's ask.
  * `ticket-fields`: labels and comments on their own routes. Inside `PATCH /api/proxy/issues/:issueId` (`routes/proxy-writes.js` \~:504), allow only `stateId`, `projectId` and `priority`/`priorityLevel`. Refuse `description`, `title`, `parentId`, `cycleId` and `assigneeId` (assignee follows `stage-writes.js`, settled at breakdown; piece 3 fixes the template). Also refuse the description routes, create and relation writes.
  * `work` and unstamped tokens keep today's behaviour. Legacy tokens stay unrestricted, so roll-out is safe. An unknown stamped value fails closed to `none`.
* Compare target tickets **case-insensitively**. Resolve alternate provider ids, or refuse with a 403 that names the ticket the stage may write to, so the agent can retry. A follow-up's token takes its own kind's `writes`, not its parent's.
* **Mint paths:** a source scan finds every caller of `provisionBootstrapToken`, `attachProxyContext`, `provisionResumeCredential` and `mintGrantBootstrap`. Each one passes its stage's allowance, or is listed as stage-less with its reason. At `5dcf5bcda` the callers are in `lib/dispatch-entrance.js`, `lib/follow-up-dispatch.js`, `lib/wake-credential.js`, `lib/chat-tools.js`, `lib/proxy-preamble.js` (:906, :939), `routes/dispatch.js`, `routes/workspace-api-feedback.js`, `routes/collective.js` (:373, :409), `routes/task-chat.js`, `routes/flight-companion.js`, `routes/proxy-tokens-admin.js` (:196, an admin grant mint, not in the plan) and `routes/test.js` (:229). `lib/dispatch-store.js` and `lib/dispatch-factory.js` name them only in comments. Don't touch the runner or `lib/dispatch-store.js`.
* Leave the preamble prose unchanged: the guard comes first, the words follow in piece 5.

**Testing (each witness fails before the change)**

* A `none` token gets a 403 from every write mount: comment, issue update, description, label, relation, create, dispatch, agent status.
* A `one-comment` token can post its comment. It is refused a comment on another ticket, a description edit and a label add.
* A triage token is refused `PATCH {description}`, not just `/description/replace`.
* The real preamble endpoints are exercised under each `writes` value and each provider's identifier form (lowercase, provider UUID, GitHub, Jira).
* A route-discovery test reads the registered write routes (POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE). It fails on any route not classified, and on any route classified as a write that has no `requireWriteScope` in its chain. Recap, brief and `/api/proxy/flight-companion/turn` are classified as not ticket writes, each with its reason. `/api/proxy/token`, which authenticates by bootstrap, is exempt. Dispatch and agent status are **not** exempt.

**Needs a ruling before merge:** with `none` enforced, look-into's "post nothing to Linear unless the person asks" becomes untrue. Retiring that exception is John's call, and it is raised as a DECISION on LIN-4448. If he keeps it, look-into gets `one-comment` instead of `none`. Don't merge until he answers.

**After merge:** comment on LIN-1273 and on LIN-1242 (#1 and #9) with the PR, saying that their read-only scope is now held at the proxy. Name the parts that stay open: merge goes to LIN-3417 / simple-dispatcher by ruling, and the Done capability (`work` keeps it) and LIN-1242's staleness lift stay where they are. **Don't close LIN-1273, or all of LIN-1242.** LIN-1372, LIN-1395 and LIN-1408 stay with A12 / the harness by ruling.

**Collisions:** piece 1 edits `lib/dispatch-entrance.js`. Open PR #2427 edits `routes/dispatch.js`. `dispatch-entrance.js`, `follow-up-dispatch.js`, `routes/dispatch.js` and `wake-credential.js` are Runs files, and the LIN-4447 seam correction lists them. `routes/proxy.js` and `lib/proxy-tokens.js` are the Agent API's files. `lib/stage-writes.js` falls to `other-features`.

**Retires:** "read-only is only words": `stageWrites` stops reaching nothing but the preamble's prose. Closes the read-only half of LIN-1273 / LIN-1242 in code.

---

**Parent:** LIN-4448 (LLM & prompts, left simpler). The full approved plan is the parent's description, section `## Implementation Plan`, and its amendments are in the parent's comment `### Plan Review Verdict` (72406236-9316-4004-98ee-70d8fba0cb09). The parent's `## As asked` block sets the scope.

Session fit: fits one session

Plan-review due: no — covered by LIN-4448's approving plan-review (comment 72406236-9316-4004-98ee-70d8fba0cb09, rev 1)

**Grounding commits:** the plan was written at `JKershaw/LinearViewer` main `2bf788b6d` (surveys at `4b5001ddf`) and reviewed at `c205190fd`. The breakdown re-checked at `5dcf5bcda`. The only change since is LIN-4457 (#2424), and the one plan file it touches is the cost-read entry in `docs/architecture/source-map.md`.

**Starting point:** the parent's approved plan. Follow it. Where the code shows it is wrong, change course, and say so in a comment on LIN-4448.

**Every PR names what it retires** (the LIN-4414 rule). It edits the Waiting entries in `docs/areas/llm-and-prompts.md` that it settles. It respects that note's Lessons and leaves `docs/reviews/` reports unchanged.

*End of what was asked. Steps write below this line; nothing above it changes.*

## Size of the move

**Size:** just the task
**Why:** Delivers the proxy refusing each stage's disallowed writes, on refired credentials and every write route too; the refired-credential gap and the route census sit inside the ask's own goal, and nothing deeper binds.
**Cuts:** none
**Decided by:** the standing policy

## Implemented

Merged: [https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2443](<https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2443>) (squash `b937237a4`, deployed). The plan was implemented as approved, with the one correction recorded on LIN-4448 (the allowance is enforced at two points: a coarse operation check before provider reads, then a ticket-identity check after target resolution), and the held-wake store edit approved by ruling. Look-into keeps `writes: none` (John retired the person-requested-comment exception); LIN-4469 drops the prompt clause. Two larger blind-read finds are Waiting entries in the area notes (PR #2446). Post-deploy live checks are listed as not run in the close-out comment. The full history is preserved in the task snapshots and the comment trail.
